THE BRIEF'S PREDICTED ORDERING DID NOT REPRODUCE. tasks/MPI-570/brief.md expected mouseenter to fire on the card a closing popup reveals, then the overlay a tick later. Measured with a real parked cursor on a cover div: card-mouseenter NEVER fired - only overlay-depth-1@10.2ms, because the overlay covered the card before the browser's hit-test pass ran. The ordering depends on how long the overlay takes to mount and is NOT derivable from the call graph. That is why the fix is a stop AND a gate: the stop covers a mouseenter landing before the push, the gate covers one landing after. Either alone would have been the 'looks right, ships, changes nothing' no-op the brief warned about - just for a different reason than the brief expected.

constraints: Bash tool: HEREDOCS ARE BLOCKED by guard-shell, and so are backslash-newline continuations. Appending a long markdown block to a plan file needs the Write tool plus a python script run by path - `cat >> file << 'EOF'` is rejected outright. Same for commit messages: write the file, then `git commit -F <path>`.

Git Bash mangles a bare Windows flag: `taskkill /PID <n> /T /F` becomes 'C:/Program Files/Git/PID' and fails. Run it through PowerShell instead - `powershell -NoProfile -Command "taskkill.exe /PID <n> /T /F"`. Also avoid inline PowerShell containing `[Math]::Min(...)` - bash chokes on the brackets; put the script in a .ps1 and run it with -File.

The isolated app does NOT need its own projects - projects live machine-wide in C:/Users/Fabio/Documents/Cubric Vision/Projects, so a fresh profile still sees all of them. The folder name is not the display name: the folder `cowboys` is the project 'The Failed Heist', which holds the flowLtxFoley_*.mp4 cards. Own profile via CUBRIC_AGENT_PROFILE=<own dir> plus CUBRIC_MODELS_ROOT=G:/CubricModels.

Opening a project does not mount the gallery. Drive it with `import('/js/router.js')` then `navigate(PAGE_GALLERY)`, and note that video thumbs are PROMOTED lazily by an IntersectionObserver - right after a navigate there may be 0 `video.mpi-group-card__thumb--video` in the DOM even though the project has 66 video groups. Wait a few seconds, and re-check after any overlay episode, which rebuilds the cards.

playwright-cli `hover` accepts a plain CSS selector, not just an eN snapshot ref - `npx playwright-cli -s=<name> hover "#some-id"` works and parks the REAL cursor, which is what any mouseenter-on-reveal measurement needs. Sessions persist across npx invocations via -s=<name>.
